program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([color (in-list (grid-colors g 0))])
    (let ((cells (find-color g color)))
      (if (= (length cells) 3)
          (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
                 (corners (list (list (first bb) (second bb))
                                (list (first bb) (fourth bb))
                                (list (third bb) (second bb))
                                (list (third bb) (fourth bb))))
                 (missing (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p cells))) corners)))
            (if (= (length missing) 1)
                (paint-cells out missing color)
                out))
          out))))
